Remaining work: (1) AC1 evidence from the first scheduled main test.yml run containing 13d4a73cde2; (2) AC2: 5 of the 6 remaining posix-api.args lines wait on design decisions held by the coordinator - (a) janitor rename-first eviction with an open reader (test_snapshot_janitor::test_eviction_rename_to_trash_open_reader_survives), (b) peak RSS on Windows (3 test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3 lines), (c) op-cert key mode on Windows (test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e::test_key_genesis_permissions_and_gitignore; cloistered-decomposed-nymph already holds an operator decision that Windows relies on the default ACL, so applying the same skip-with-reason is the likely path, pending confirmation). The 6th line, test_opcert_own_pub_resolution_d26a::test_certifies_when_the_key_dir_is_read_only, is intentionally unsupported on Windows: chmod cannot make a Windows directory unwritable (the read-only attribute is ignored on directories), and the test now skips there with that reason.
